extra.final_summary: The data had three issues affecting the question: 1) 'dream' in the 'island' column was a lowercase variant of 'Dream' and was normalized; 2) whitespace variants of 'male' in the 'sex' column were normalized to 'male'; 3) one row (row 51) had an invalid flipper length of -195 mm, which was below the minimum allowed 170 mm and negative, so it was excluded. After these fixes, the analysis showed 28 penguins on Biscoe, 25 on Dream, and 11 on Torgersen.
